items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: I think he's working with Ray Charles and Lloyd Brice.

ctx.x: He and Lil Jack is on trumpet.

Lil Jack? Yeah, and Louis Cottrell is playing clarinet. What's Lil Jack? A little short talk. Yeah. Must be the same Lil Jack. He's all in the music. A little bit of a hook to his nose maybe. Probably the same Jack that started out with me. I think he's working with Ray Charles and Lloyd Brice. Yeah, yeah, he's been around. Yeah, he's been around. Old Ray Charles. Oh no.
Yeah, well he's making it now. He's really, he's got accepted, you know, Ray Charles. Yeah, this boy, this guy, I came along with Tom, Tom Jefferson, one of the trumpet players that played a lot.
